post.excerpt: The past few years have been marked by tremendous growth for CloudFlare. At the time of our last fundraising in December 2012, CloudFlare was a team of 37 operating a network in 23 cities and 15 countries—today we number over 200 with a presence in 62 cities and 33 countries.
post.title: Why we raised $110m from Fidelity, Google, Microsoft, Baidu and Qualcomm
